instruction: Design a system that combines the Gray code and priority encoder modules to create a 4-bit encoder that outputs the binary reflected Gray code (BRGC) of the highest-priority input that is low. The system should use a structural design approach and instantiate one 4-bit BRGC module and one 4-to-2 priority encoder module. Additionally, the system should include an addictive functional module that takes in both the outputs of the two given modules to get a final output. The output should be the BRGC of the highest-priority input that is low.
